name: jjal-tok
description: GIF 이미지를 임시 저장소에 다운로드하여 카카오톡으로 빠르게 전송하는 Chrome 확장 프로그램

scripts.build: web-ext build --overwrite-dest --filename "jjaltok-{version}.xpi" --ignore-files "native-host/**" "web-ext-artifacts/**" ".claude/**" ".DS_Store" CLAUDE.md package.json create-icons.html generate-icons.js "icons/generate-icons.html" "icons/README.md"
scripts.lint: web-ext lint --self-hosted --ignore-files "native-host/**" "web-ext-artifacts/**" ".claude/**" ".DS_Store" CLAUDE.md package.json create-icons.html generate-icons.js "icons/generate-icons.html" "icons/README.md"
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --channel unlisted --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --ignore-files "native-host/**" "web-ext-artifacts/**" ".claude/**" ".DS_Store" CLAUDE.md package.json create-icons.html generate-icons.js "icons/generate-icons.html" "icons/README.md"

author: kabkee
